polityNote: Republic of South Africa from the nine-province constitution of 1994-04-27 (Interim Constitution). Before that the four provinces and the bantustans (TBVC states claimed independent) are not expressible with these atoms. NE shows the provinces after the 2009 Sixteenth Amendment (verified: Carletonville/Khutsong in Gauteng, Matatiele in Eastern Cape, Umzimkulu in KwaZulu-Natal, Bushbuckridge in Mpumalanga, Groblersdal/Marble Hall in Limpopo).
